tickets.description: Agents take work themselves in INT-04 order.
acceptanceCriteria: Returned-from-review first, then priority, then oldest

tickets.title: Event Log source filters

acceptanceCriteria: Each source can be shown alone

tickets.title: Guard ticket lifecycle transitions
tickets.description: Only the transitions from the lifecycle diagram are possible, for Operator and agents alike.
acceptanceCriteria: Backlog → Done is refused
Operator cannot move In Progress → Review

tickets.title: Stage stepper on agent card
tickets.description: Agent card shows Planning → Implementing → Testing → Awaiting Review with the current stage highlighted (MC-03).
acceptanceCriteria: Current stage is highlighted
Idle looks different from every working stage
tickets.reviewSummary: Stepper renders four stages; Idle is shown as an empty track.

tickets.title: Health thresholds for Stale / Offline
tickets.description: Mission Control must tell a slow agent from a dead one. Derive Agent Health from the time since last activity, using the thresholds from PDR-0002. A long-running tool call must not make the agent look Stale.
acceptanceCriteria: Online while the last activity is under 30 s old
Stale after 30 s, Offline after 2 min of silence
An in-flight tool call keeps the agent Online
Stale and Offline differ by shape and label, not only colour
tickets.reviewSummary: Agent Health is derived from the time since the last activity: Online up to 30 s, Stale up to 2 min, Offline after that. A tool call in flight keeps the agent Online. Unit tests cover all three boundaries.

tickets.title: Seed demo tickets on first run
tickets.description: Fill an empty board with demo tickets on first launch (SIM-04).
acceptanceCriteria: Runs only when the board is empty
Covers different priorities
tickets.blockedQuestion: Which priorities should the demo tickets cover?

acceptanceCriteria: M picks up the focused card; arrows choose a column

The result is announced to screen readers

tickets.title: Persist board filters in URL
tickets.description: Agent and Blocked filters survive a reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters are encoded in the URL

tickets.title: Show tool duration in Event Log

acceptanceCriteria: Duration is shown for finished tools

acceptanceCriteria: Reconnect sends Last-Event-ID
